text:
Sam: Having a weird onboarding issue — our sampleapp fails after a key rotation and it's confusing users.
Lyla: Can you show logs or steps?
Sam: Steps: start with REDWOOD_API_KEY in .env, deploy, rotate keys in dashboard, then requests start 401ing. CLI shows a different project id in headers and SDK ends up using an old project-scoped key.
Marta: Which SDK/version?
Sam: python 0.12.2 and js 0.11.8. They behave differently: python throws a clear auth error, js silently falls back to an org-scoped key and keeps retrying.
Ken: Oof — parity + UX bug. Also noticed env var naming is inconsistent across sample repos: sometimes we use REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY, sometimes REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT.
Sam: Found this in sampleapp dockerfile which explains it:
```bash
# docker env snippet
ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY=abc123
ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT=proj-987
```
Lyla: That mismatch would cause the SDK to read the wrong var depending on language loader. CLI precedence we expect is: CLI flag > REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY > REDWOOD_API_KEY > instance metadata. SDKs should mirror that.
Marta: Proposal: (1) normalize env var names to REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY (deprecate REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT), (2) make SDKs error loudly when they detect ambiguous combos with a helpful message and remediation steps, (3) update sampleapp and onboarding docs to a single canonical example.
Ken: Addendum — when rotation happens, SDKs should emit a redacted key hint in logs/trace (e.g., using masked fingerprint) so users know which credential was used. Telemetry event for failed auth + key-origin would help debugging.
Sam: For immediate mitigation I'd rather the js SDK stop auto-falling-back and instead return a helpful error mentioning `--project` flag and env var mismatch.
Lyla: Can the CLI add a short migration shim that maps REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT -> REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY with a deprecation warning? That will reduce onboarding breakage.
Marta: Yes — I'll own the doc + sampleapp updates and add the migration shim ticket.
Ken: I'll take the js SDK change (remove fallback + add error + add masked key in logs).
Lyla: I'll implement the CLI shim + deprecation notice and add a one-liner in the quickstart.
Marta: Action items: Marta — sampleapp + docs PR; Ken — js SDK PR; Lyla — CLI shim PR. We'll coordinate on a shared test that exercises rotation.
rotation-bot: scheduled credential rotation for sampleorg in 12h (info). :robot_face:
Sam: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
